title: Soft-commit flexible SKU pilot: GTM & release notes orchestration for Dedicated capacity
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: run a pilot soft-commit SKU for Dedicated capacity that offers flexible reservation terms (soft commitments with seasonal burst), coordinate cross-functional GTM activities, and produce coordinated release notes and customer communication. Goals: validate demand signal in EU regions, ensure billing accuracy for partial commitments, provide a clear rollout path for field and docs, and avoid SLA regressions. This ticket owns GTM orchestration (field enablement, pricing comms, release notes sequence, marketplace updates, partner outreach) and tracks dependent engineering and docs deliverables. Trade-offs discussed: delayed feature parity with full reservations to compress timeline for pilot vs. potential confusion for customers (mitigated by clear release notes and limit to beta customers). We will run a 6-week pilot with up to 10 customers and measure conversion to full reservations.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot offering live in eu-central-1 and eu-west-1 for selected customers
Billing and metering validated against 3 synthetic workloads (50/70/90% utilization) and documented in billing matrix
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal and Billing, and scheduled for publishing on release date
Field enablement package (playbook + FAQ + price calculator) reviewed and accepted by Sales Ops
Telemetry dashboard for pilot KPIs (conversion, usage, overage, latency) accessible to PM and Eng leads
tasks: Finalize SKU definitions and pricing bands (PM, Finance)
Add soft-commit SKU to Dedicated capacity configuration UI (ENG)
Implement metering rule updates in billing pipeline (ENG/Finance)
Create release notes draft and customer email templates (PM/Docs)
Build field enablement playbook and training slide deck (PM/SE)
Coordinate partner marketplace entry listing with Partnerships
Run QA for SLA behavior and fallback policies with runtime team
Recruit 6-10 pilot customers and sign pilot agreements
